tool_args.rationale: The onset/base-field/sink-gradient signatures specifically identify the archived barrier-modulated siphon family. Seven varied-u and varied-s observations now constrain its four parameters; refit that law with broad multistart numerical optimization to address possible local-minimum failure before spending on unrelated probes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The branch-discriminating probe already covered low and high sink gradients; the immediate issue is the failed barrier fit, not an unmeasured branch sign.
The observed signatures and candidate are a direct static flux law, not the archived memory ODE; trajectory rows would be costly and poorly targeted.
Only one stationary mechanism has been tested, and the refutation does not demonstrate chaotic/non-stationary behavior or refute all smooth mechanisms.
